Corollary
[Injectivity Radius Comparison] ↗ thm:conjugate-points-ricci-bounded 1. ch11:11.17

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 11.16, \[ \operatorname {inj}(p)\leq \pi R \qquad (p\in M). \]

Proof

\sketch Radial geodesics in a geodesic ball are minimizing, while a geodesic segment containing a conjugate point cannot minimize beyond it. Theorem 11.16 therefore bounds every geodesic-ball radius by $\pi R$.

□
